title: Commercial Gas Agreement Scale on Noticed C&I Termination Damages
content:
**Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts - noticed terminations: commercial gas agreement on the same premise.**

The damages rate of a noticed termination is scaled by the Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement, under Commercial Natural Gas Supply, on the same premise: an active gas agreement with no drop requested scales it by 0.92, a gas agreement in drop pending status with a drop requested scales it by 0.96, and any other case, including no gas agreement on the premise, leaves it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the damages rate per kWh by the figure shown.

The records read are the Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement on the premise of the terminating C&I contract: its status and its drop requested date, a blank drop requested date meaning that no drop has been requested.

| Gas agreement status | Drop requested date | Damages rate multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| active | blank | 0.92 |
| active | present | 1, unscaled |
| drop pending | present | 0.96 |
| drop pending | blank | 1, unscaled |
| any other status | either | 1, unscaled |
| no commercial gas agreement on the premise | none | 1, unscaled |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A rate of $0.0080 per kWh on a facility whose commercial gas agreement is active with no drop requested becomes 0.0080 multiplied by 0.92, that is $0.00736 per kWh, carried unrounded into the damages.
